paite: Paul, Khrist Jesu hentapa leh i unaupa Timothi in, ka deihtak leh ka sepgimpih uh Philemon kiang leh,
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: ka sanggamnu uh Apphia kiang ah, ka sepaihpih uh Arkippas kiang leh na inn a saptuam kikhawmte kiang ah leng:
Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Ka thumnate ah na min lou gige in, ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi.
heading: Philemon Itna leh Ginna

paite: Toupa Jesu lam leh misiangthou tengteng lam a itna leh ginna na neih za in.
Na ginna kikoppihna, noumau a om thil hoih chiteng theihkimna lam ah Khrist lam a ahong phattuam theihna ding in.
Unaupa aw, nangmah ziak a misiangthoute lungtang ahong halh tak ziak in na itna ah ka kipak in ka kha amuang mahmah hi.
Huaiziak in akilawm hun hih ding in nang thu hon piak Khrist ah kingap mah leng,
heading: Onesimas A Dia Ngetsakna

paite: itna ziak in, Paul putek hial hita leh, tu a Khrist Jesu hentapa hita in, anget in ka hon ngen zaw hi.
Ka ta Onesimas, kolbun kawm a ka neihkhiak, amah a ding in na kiang ah ka ngetsak hi.
Tuma lam in nang a ding in aphatuam kei a, tu'n zaw kei leh nang a ding in aphatuamta hi.
Amah, ka lungtang mahmah na kiang ah ka hon sawlkik nawn hi.
Amah tanchinhoih a ka kolbutna a nangmah sik a nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in ka kiang a omsak nilouh ka ut mahmah hi.
Himahleh na hehpihna hehpihsak teitei bang hilou in, na thu bang ahihtheih zawkna ding in, na thu lou in bangmah hih ka ut kei hi.
Sawt lou kal nang ahon khen tangtawn a amah na neih tawntungna ding ziak ahi kha mai ding hi,
himahleh sikha bang hi nawn lou a, sikha sang a hoih unau deihtak bang zaw in; kei a ding in deihtak ahi diak a, nang a ding ngial in sa leh Toupa ah nak hihna in chia!
Huchi in lawm a na hon simleh keimah bang in amah na kipahpih in.
Huan na tung a banghiam ahihkhelh a, na thil banghiam abatleh keimah bat in bawl in.
Kei Paul in, keimah khut ngei a ka gelh ahi. Keimah in ka ditsak ding hi; ka kiang a nangma'n leng bat na neih sam dan hon hilh bel ka hi kei hi.
Ahi, unaupa aw, nangmah ziak in Toupa ah kipahna hon neisak inla, Khrist ah leng ka lungtang hihhalh in.
Ka gen sang a thupizaw tham in na hih ding chih ka theih ziak in, na hon thuman ding chih muang in na kiang ah ka gelh ahi.
Akoi abang hitaleh, huai kia hih lou in, tunna ding hon na suktuahsak in; na thumnate uh ziak in na kiang ua piak ka hi ding chih ka kigingta hi.
Epaphras, Khrist Jesu a ka hentakpihpa'n chibai ahon buk hi;
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanung

paite: huchi mah bang in ka seppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas leh Lukate'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen, Amen.
